verdict.rationale: Requesty documents its own analytics dashboard that tracks costs, requests, tokens, cache savings and latency in real time, which covers the metrics in this story. The evidence describes usage analytics, though, not a per-request log where a platform engineer can inspect individual request and response payloads with those metrics attached. Missing for 10: documented per-request log view, request/response body inspection, per-entry attachment of latency/tokens/cost, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can inspect logged requests and responses with latency, token counts, and cost attached

citations.quote: Track costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency, all in real-time.
